unit_boundary: ONE corrective legacy ConditionsExpr contribution with an actual existing MemoryStudy service consumer. Parser/native/browser/UI/CI are support, not extra product or portfolio units, participants or independent studies.
question: Can strictly typed authored conditions change actual service eligibility in the existing private owner without bypassing observed help/support/recent evidence, coin cost or actual delivery?
selection_disagreement: Scientific analysis initially preferred a finite new field-aid action. That would require original numeric effects because source consumable HP/SP columns are blank. The selected corrective legacy contract instead evaluates ConditionsExpr and actual ordered service use, without another wrapper or numeric consumable grant.
baseline: Independent benches remain the default policy. An immutable ordered policy adds East OtherDelivered=true before its actual service; all baseline Helped/Support/Recent/Coins>0/notDelivered requirements remain nonbypassable. Conditions are observations, not actions or goods.
rivals: A condition parser may silently repair unknown identifiers/types/operators or permissively accept malformed expressions.
A true expression or eligible button may be mistaken for actual delivered fitting or payment.
Client fields, another bench, promises, expiry or elapsed wall time may fabricate known facts or bypass baseline requirements.
A rendered eligibility/output picture may disagree with the actual private owner.
planned_execution: Run the actual existing .NET10 MemoryStudy host and original browser UI, with explicit startup independent versus ordered policy.
Use actual form/buttons and command/state endpoints; no HP/inventory/flag fixtures, owner replacement or direct state injection.
Compare the same paid East help then service in independent versus ordered policy: independent accepts actual service, ordered refuses without cost until West actually supplies its fitting.
Verify that ordered condition=true cannot acquire East fitting, spend a coin or advance a turn until the actual explicit service command.
Preserve actual source literal semantics, typed limits and unsupported syntax; no Ruby/RGSS/RMXP execution follows from C# compilation or staged source comparison.
Check expiry, withdrawal/wrong-bench requirements, no-cost refusal and one delivered output per bench.
Check two specific isolated actual renderer mutants: false eligibility and false delivered output. Verify actual owner condition first and require the intended fidelity assertion.
Retain any failed/superseded instruments and bind initial/final source identities; stop owned hosts.

Before browser execution, include one bounded ordered-policy FieldJourney composition: actual private Memory policy, refused East bypass, real West/East service, component allocation, rig consumption and actual survey without fabricated final completion or workshop clock advance. This is integration support of the same unit, not a new study.
limits: Software controls overlap outcomes, not people, populations, independent studies, human testimony or measured effort.
Actual authored service policy uses known private facts only; unknown/global/wildcard source memory is not authority.
No full dialogue selector/scoring/quest catalogue, source coercion, historical engine execution, Unity/Windows/Steam, human readability/balance or commercial clearance is established.
Independent analyses/agent review are not human validation or author approval.

brain_influence.SCI-014: Separate typed evaluation, observed actions and human constructs.
brain_influence.SCI-076: Use real consumer/state/picture controls for software assertions, reserve comprehension for actual participants.
brain_influence.SCI-077: Retain negatives and avoid duplicate participant/effort/source-credit counting.
